summary: Win32 MoveFileA wrapper that reports failures. Calls MoveFileA through the import; on success clears the error code, on failure captures GetLastError. When an error is present it is routed through ErrorIDLookupTable and the function returns -1; otherwise it returns 0.

operations.description: Call MoveFileA(lpExistingFileName, lpNewFileName) via the import at 0x0059E1D8; branch on its success result.
On failure capture LastError = GetLastError() via the import at 0x0059E188.
If LastError is zero, return 0 immediately.
Report the captured error through ErrorIDLookupTable(LastError).
Return -1 when an error was reported.

unresolved: ErrorIDLookupTable side effects (message lookup vs. logging) are not evidenced in the packet.
